note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: inbox
datasets.select: SELECT id,type,title,content,is_read,push_time,expire_time FROM user_inbox WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_inbox WHERE user_id=?
datasets.eligible: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_inbox WHERE user_id=? AND push_time<?
datasets.cleanup: UPDATE user_inbox SET title='[已清理]',content='[已清理]' WHERE user_id=? AND push_time<?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
